API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPolicy ResourcesGet Ip Groups
Get Ip Groups
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ipGroups

Retrieves the list of IP pools. To learn more, see About IP Pool.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to match against the IP pool parameters.

Responses
​
default

Default Response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

ID of the IP address group or IP pool.

name
string

Name of the IP address group or IP pool.

ipAddresses
string[]

IP addresses included in the IP group or IP pool.

description
string

Description of the IP group or IP pool.

creatorContext
string

Indicates whether the IP group or IP pool is created in Cloud & Branch Connector (EC) or ZIA.

Possible values: [ZIA, EC]

isNonEditable
boolean

Indicates if the IP group is view-only (true) or is editable (false).

]
